# Project glue

<!-- Generated by the chisel setup questionnaire (sections A–G below). This
file is the GLUE: the single indirection point rules and skills read to
resolve project-specific paths and behaviour. `init` writes it once from the
questionnaire answers below (each pre-filled with its default); `update`
re-renders the managed parts of the socle but never touches this file. -->

## A · Task workspace

<!-- Questionnaire asks: where do tasks, archive, changelog, roadmap, and the
task template live? Default is root `/project-management/`; an
Astro-embedded variant may nest it elsewhere. -->

- **Tasks root:** `/project-management/`
- **Tasks:** `/project-management/tasks/`
- **Archive:** `/project-management/archive/`
- **Changelog:** `/project-management/CHANGELOG.md`
- **Roadmap:** `/project-management/ROADMAP.md`
- **Task file template:** `/project-management/000-task-file-template.md`
- **Task id script:** `/scripts/task-id.sh`

## B · Tracker

<!-- Questionnaire asks: local markdown (the default), or an external
tracker (GitHub Issues, Plane)? This section absorbs what used to be a
separate issue-tracker doc in the socle — rules and skills that referenced
it now read this section instead; nothing else changes when the tracker
changes. -->

**Mode: local markdown.** Work is tracked as task files in this repo — there
is no external tracker wired up for now.

- **Active tasks:** `<Tasks>/<time-id>-<intention>.md` (see Section A),
  where `<time-id>` is generated by `<Task id script>` (`YYYYMMDD-HHmm`, for
  automatic chronological sorting). Large tasks may be split into slice files
  under `<Tasks>/<time-id>-<feature-slug>/<NN>-<slice-slug>.md`, numbered in
  dependency order (see the `slice-task` skill)
- **Completed tasks:** moved to `<Archive>` (see Section A)
- **Format:** the template at `<Task file template>` (see Section A)
  (reading-gradient zones: 🧑 review carefully / 🧑 review if relevant / 🤖
  agent zone)
- **Status:** the `**Status:**` field in each task file (🔴 🟡 🟠 🟢 ⚪ ⚫)
- **Work the frontier:** any task/slice whose blockers are all done can start

### Switching to an external tracker later

To move to Linear, GitHub Issues, or Plane, rewrite this section with the new
workflow (how to fetch a ticket, how to publish, which labels). The skills and
rules read this file — nothing else needs to change. When an external tracker
owns the business spec, the agent must check the ticket for updates before
working on a task derived from it.
